diagnostics.coldStart: Cold start — the cache expired and needs to be re-primed.
diagnostics.compacted: Context compaction ran — the cache prefix is being re-primed.
diagnostics.visionFallback: {{model}} cannot handle images — trying a vision-capable model.
diagnostics.visionDemoted: No vision model available — screenshots demoted to text stubs. Set a Vision fallback (e.g. Gemini) under Settings → Agent for full computer use.
diagnostics.resumedTurn: Resuming the interrupted agent work from the last checkpoint…
diagnostics.partialPreserved: _(Stream interrupted on {{model}} — partial reply preserved. Retrying…)_
diagnostics.compactedSmart: Context compacted with a model-written summary — the cache prefix is being re-primed.
diagnostics.toolResultsCleared: Cleared {{count}} old tool results (~{{tokens}}k tokens) to keep the context focused — full text stays available to the agent
diagnostics.decisionComplexity: Decision model rated this request {{to}} ({{pct}}%, {{model}}); the heuristic said {{from}}
diagnostics.escalateOnVerifyFail: Checks failed twice — escalating the fix to a stronger model.

errors.noProvider: No provider or model configured. Open Settings → Providers, then Settings → Models.
errors.allAttemptsFailed: All model attempts failed. Last error: {{error}}
errors.noUsableModel: No usable model. Check that a provider is enabled and has models attached.
errors.noVisionModel: This request needs images, but no vision-capable model is available. In Settings → Models mark Gemini/GPT-4o/Claude as Vision, enable its provider, and set Vision fallback under Settings → Agent.
errors.noVisionFallbackDisabled: Vision fallback model is disabled. Re-enable it under Settings → Models, or pick another Vision model in Settings → Agent.
errors.noVisionFallbackProvider: Vision fallback model’s provider is off or missing. Enable the Google/OpenAI/Claude provider under Settings → Providers.
errors.toolLoop: Tool loop detected: repeated the same calls ({{names}}) {{rounds}} rounds without progress. Stopping.
errors.maxRounds: Stopped after {{rounds}} tool rounds without a final answer.
errors.emptyResponse: The model returned an empty reply. Try again, or switch to a stronger model.
errors.sessionBudgetHit: Stopped: this chat's spend reached ${{cost}} (cap ${{cap}}). Raise the limit in Settings → Usage, or start a new chat.
errors.dailyBudgetHit: Stopped: today's spend reached ${{cost}} (cap ${{cap}}). Raise the limit under Settings → Usage.
errors.stuckAskUser: The agent stopped because it kept getting stuck ({{detail}}). It summarized what it tried above — tell it how to proceed.

remoteSection.securityNote: Commands run with the host account’s permissions. The first connection trusts the host key (accept-new).

modelSection.title: Models
modelSection.desc: Manage available models. Prefer Sync models on a provider so the list comes from their API instead of stale seeds. Mark vision capability so text-only models can fall back automatically.
modelSection.pricingDesc: Pricing (USD / 1M tokens) — used for router cost math and cache savings. Leave blank if unknown.
modelSection.visionHint: Yes = can see attached images/screenshots. No = text only (router will fall back). Auto = guess from the model id.

agentSection.title: Agent
agentSection.desc: Routing, permissions, and shell safety for the main agent
agentSection.routingDesc: Automatically route tasks to the best available model
agentSection.visionFallbackDesc: Optional. Used only when the active model cannot handle images (attachments or screenshots). If your main model already has vision (e.g. Gemini), leave this on Auto — nothing extra is needed.
agentSection.visionFallbackEmpty: No vision-capable models yet. Add one under Models and set Vision to Yes (or use a Gemini/GPT-4o/Claude preset).
agentSection.sendModeDesc: Choose how messages are sent to the agent
agentSection.permissionModeDesc: Control how the agent asks for permissions
agentSection.harnessDesc_default: Neutral. Your settings are used as-is.
agentSection.harnessDesc_eco: Token saver: value models, low reasoning, short replies, early compaction, 2 parallel helpers.
agentSection.harnessDesc_maxing: Token maxing: frontier models, deep reasoning, wide exploration, 8 parallel helpers. Simple work still goes to cheap models.
agentSection.harnessManualHint: Manual routing: model choice stays pinned; other mode effects still apply.
agentSection.harnessNoHighTier: No high-tier model enabled, so Maxing model picks will feel similar.
agentSection.harnessNoLowTier: No low-tier model enabled, so Eco model picks will feel similar.
agentSection.shellSandboxDesc: Env allowlist + dangerous-command block for agent shell_exec (default on)
agentSection.shellNetworkDesc: Allow network in sandboxed shells (off uses sandbox-exec on macOS when possible)
agentSection.cwdJailDesc: Refuse shell cwd outside the project root
agentSection.autoMemoryConsolidateDesc: Merge near-duplicate memory cards after each answer
agentSection.smartCompactionDesc: When the context fills up, the cheapest enabled model writes a handoff summary (goal, decisions, changed files, open work). Off = free heuristic digest.
agentSection.lspDiagnosticsDesc: Run installed language servers (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust) so the agent sees real errors right after each edit and can jump to definitions/references.
agentSection.toolLoadingDesc: Smart sends core coding tools always and loads browser, computer, account (GitHub/GitLab/Google/CodeCommit) and app tools only when a chat needs them — about half the tool tokens per request. All sends every tool.
agentSection.computerUseDesc: Control apps on this Mac: accessibility-tree actions, screenshots and zoom, OCR, mouse and keyboard, windows and menus. Needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permission. Press Esc twice to stop the agent.
agentSection.computerSettingUp: Setting up… preparing the helper and opening permission prompts. Turn on Pawn in System Settings.
agentSection.computerUnavailable: Computer use is only available in the desktop app.
agentSection.nativeComputerToolDesc: On the Anthropic API, give Claude its own trained computer tool (batched actions, best click accuracy). Pawn's accessibility, OCR, app and menu tools stay available.
agentSection.nativeCodingToolsDesc: Give each model the editing tools it was trained on: Claude's text editor and persistent bash on the Anthropic API, apply_patch for GPT models. Undo, permissions and verification still apply.
agentSection.search: permission sandbox send mode compaction context budget vision fallback ultra work auto verify

agentsSection.title: Subagents
agentsSection.desc: Build specialized helpers the main chat can hand work off to—research, planning, implementation, review, and more. Pawn ships with ready-made roles; yours are saved with the project or on this device.
agentsSection.builtinDesc_worker: General-purpose implementer: explore + edit + verify in an isolated environment.
agentsSection.builtinDesc_code-reviewer: Reviews code for quality, security, and maintainability. (Read-only)
agentsSection.builtinDesc_explore: Fast read-only codebase search and analysis.
agentsSection.builtinDesc_plan: Read-only research agent used before writing a plan.
agentsSection.builtinDesc_synthesizer: Writes structured reports from collected research material.
agentsSection.customEmpty: No custom agents yet. Tap “New agent”, or copy a built-in role and tweak it.
agentsSection.fieldNameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Stored as a small file under .pawn/agents.
agentsSection.fieldDescriptionPh: When should the main chat pick this agent?
agentsSection.fieldToolsHint: Comma-separated tool names. Leave empty to allow the usual set (minus anything you deny below).
agentsSection.fieldSkillsHint: Comma-separated skill names. Their guides are loaded for this agent only.
agentsSection.fieldPathAllowHint: Only these paths may be edited (e.g. src/**). Leave empty to allow anything not blocked below.
agentsSection.fieldPathDenyHint: Never touch these paths (e.g. .env, secrets folders).
agentsSection.maxParallelDesc: How many agents can work side by side. Extra jobs wait in line.
agentsSection.maxParallelHarness: Applies in Default mode. Eco uses {{eco}}, Maxing uses {{maxing}}.
agentsSection.autoOpenPanelDesc: Show a compact activity bar in the chat while helpers work, and expand it to see what each one is doing.
agentsSection.errNoProject: Open a project to save for this project, or choose “This device”.
agentsSection.errDeleteClaude: You can edit Claude Code agents here, but only Pawn-saved agents can be deleted from this screen.
agentsSection.costModeDesc: Default model budget when helpers run. A stronger model set on a specific agent still wins.
agentsSection.costFrugalDesc: Prefer cheaper models. Research stays light; implementers may use a mid-tier model. No automatic upgrades.
agentsSection.costBalancedDesc: Recommended. Light research, mid-tier planning/review, freer choice for implementers—within safe bounds.
agentsSection.costQualityDesc: Use the best available model when it helps. Still reuses cached context to limit cost when possible.
agentsSection.parallelHint: When work can be split up, Pawn can run several helpers at the same time (up to six) so independent tasks finish faster. Watch them live in the chat, or open the Agents panel for full history.

hooksSection.title: Hooks
hooksSection.desc: Run scripts at agent lifecycle points (Claude/Codex-compatible). Sources merge with dedupe so the same command is not run twice. PreToolUse deny wins even in YOLO.
hooksSection.enabledDesc: Fire lifecycle hooks from Claude and Pawn config files
hooksSection.allowProjectHooksDesc: Run hooks from the opened repo's .claude/settings.json / .pawn/hooks.json. Off by default — those files ship with untrusted repos and can execute arbitrary commands. User-scope hooks always run.
hooksSection.empty: No hooks found. Add them under ~/.claude/settings.json or ~/.pawn/hooks.json.
hooksSection.desktopOnly: Hooks run in the desktop app.
hooksSection.search: hooks pre post tool permission script

modsSection.desc: Trusted local scripts that can observe or answer tool calls, prompts, and UI draws while you chat. Review capabilities before enabling.
modsSection.trustBody:
There is no sandbox.
Review the events and APIs, then enable only code you trust.
modsSection.enabledDesc:
When off, installed mods stay on disk but do not run.
Skills and MCP stay available.
modsSection.readClaudeDesc:

Off by default. Turn it on only if you trust those plugins.
modsSection.readClaudeConfirm: Scan Claude Code plugins for mods? They run with your full permissions after you allow each one.
modsSection.noneActive: No mods are active in this chat yet
modsSection.onboardingDesc: Install the sample, or pick a folder that already has a hooks module.
modsSection.exampleInstalled: Sample installed — review it to allow
modsSection.installedDesc: Loaded from your folder, extra folders, and this project.
modsSection.empty: Nothing here yet. Install the sample or choose a folder.
modsSection.consentBody: This mod runs in-process with your account permissions. Check what it hooks before allowing.
modsSection.consentWarn: You can turn it off later. Untrusted code can read files and run commands.

decisionSection.title: Decision models
decisionSection.desc: Optional. A decision model answers typed questions (pick one, score, yes or no) with calibrated probabilities in milliseconds instead of writing text. Pawn works the same without one; with one, the agent makes faster, cheaper judgments.
decisionSection.desktopOnly: Decision models are available in the desktop app.
decisionSection.empty: No decision model yet. Add TypeSafe for hosted Jev, or Ollaya to run open models on this machine.

presets.typesafe: Hosted Jev, the first-party decision model. Needs an API key.
presets.ollaya: Open models such as Laya and Winnow on your machine. Data never leaves it.
presets.custom: Any server that speaks the TypeSafe API.

decisionSection.activeHint: Use this provider. Only one decision model is active at a time.
decisionSection.removeConfirm: Remove this decision model? Its saved API key is deleted from this device.

hints.typesafe: Paste an API key from the TypeSafe console. TypeSafe bills Jev per input token.
hints.ollaya: Open the Ollaya app or run `ollaya serve`, then `ollaya pull laya` (or another model). No key needed unless the server sets OLLAYA_API_KEY.
hints.custom: Enter the API root of a TypeSafe-compatible server. Pawn calls /v1/systemone on it.

features.agentToolDesc: Adds a decide tool for fast triage, ranking and checks, like sorting 50 log lines or checking a claim against a source
features.shellRiskGuardDesc: Rates each shell command. When one that would run without asking looks destructive, Pawn asks you first. It only adds prompts, never skips one.
features.routerAssistDesc: When the model picker is on Auto, the decision model judges how hard each new request is. That sets the tier of chat model that answers (low, mid or high). Needs models in at least two tiers. Adds a short wait before each reply.
